sections.heading: Latest news
sections.lead: What we have been doing, and what is coming.

items.title: Stakeholder workshop at Nyayo House brings ministries, banks and counties together
body: Presenters from the Ministry of Labour & Social Protection, the Business Registration Service, the Kenya Revenue Authority, the National Judiciary Mediation Department, Nairobi City County and partner financial institutions set out what each requires from grassroots groups — and where the process currently breaks.
The session produced agreed referral routes and a commitment to publish requirements in a form groups can act on.

items.title: Digital platform pilot opens self-registration to the first cohort of groups
body: Groups in Nairobi began self-registering and tracking applications through the CECF digital platform, linking directly to the Ministry of Labour & Social Protection and the Kenya Revenue Authority.

items.title: Financial inclusion agreement covering group accounts and enterprise financing
body: A partnership framework covering group account structures, group lending, LPO financing, asset financing, pre-vetting pipelines and joint financial literacy delivery.

items.title: Leadership forum convenes representatives from 500 socioeconomic groups
body: Group leaders set the agenda themselves. The three issues raised most often were the cost of registration, the distance to the nearest office, and disputes that had gone unresolved for years.
